title: SmartAntiCheat
description: Lightweight anti-cheat plugin for Paper servers with fly, reach, and combat detection.
body:
# SmartAntiCheat

SmartAntiCheat is a Paper anti-cheat plugin.

## Features

- Fly hack detection
- Reach detection
- KillAura detection
- AutoTotem detection
- AutoShield detection
- Admin alerts
- OP bypass support

## Installation

1. Put the plugin into plugins folder
2. Restart server

## Permissions

smartac.alert

## Notes

- OP players are never kicked
- Alerts go to admins and console
